Title: New features for Windows Server containers in Azure Kubernetes Service

Body.Content:
Several new features for Windows Server containers in Azure Kubernetes Service are now available. The following summarizes these new features:

Diagnostics support for Windows Server containers in AKS: Azure Kubernetes Service diagnostics (preview) now supports Windows Server containers. Learn more.

Node auto-repair for Windows Server containers in AKS: Azure Kubernetes Service node auto-repair now detects unhealthy Windows Server nodes and automatically repairs them when issues are encountered (GA). Learn more.
